sloka: उत्क्रामन्तं दरीवन्तं हिमवत्सन्निभं गिरिम् ।पश्यमानस्ततो विन्ध्यं रावणो नर्मदां ययौ ।। ७.३१.१८ ॥
transliteration: utkrāmantaṁ darīvantaṁ himavatsannibhaṁ girim ।paśyamānastato vindhyaṁ rāvaṇo narmadāṁ yayau ।। 7.31.18 ॥

translations.english: Ravana, after observing the Vindhya mountain, which rose high, possessed many caves, and resembled the Himalayas, then proceeded to the Narmada river.
